engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Power Locks operating at random while driving.
Radio doesn't turn off when key is removed from Ignition.
No audible confirmation from alarm horn when arming alarm system.
On the Eos, the front windows may drop down a little if rolled up all the way.
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri harness issue
stepByStepSolution: Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  the Ignition Switch (Electrical Portion).
technicalNotes:
Often times this is found with the one or more of the following codes:
00576 - Terminal 15: Electrical Fault in Circuit
00883 - Ignition Switch (D) Terminal S : Electrical Fault in Circuit
01744 - Ignition Switch Terminal P (D) : Electrical Fault in Circuit
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
